title: Aperiodicity properties of automorphism groups of free products
summary: Let $G=G_1 \ast \ldots \ast G_k \ast F_N$ be a free product of finitely presented groups, where $F_N$ is a free group of rank $N \in \mathbb{N}$. Let $\mathrm{Out}(G,\mathcal{G})$ be the subgroup of $\mathrm{Out}(G)$ preserving the set of conjugacy classes $\mathcal{G}=\{[G_1],\ldots,[G_k]\}$. Under natural conditions on the groups $G_i$ with $i \in \{1,\ldots,k\}$, we prove that the group $\mathrm{Out}(G,\mathcal{G})$ has a finite index subgroup $\mathrm{IA}(G,\mathcal{G},3)$ with notable aperiodicity properties.
